concerns.text: Task T014z mandates creating a hardcoded lookup table for Kinetic Diameter, Lennard-Jones epsilon, and Quadrupole Moment from 'verified literature'. This violates Spec FR-001 ('MUST calculate... using RDKit') and Constitution Principle VI ('No hand-calculated or externally sourced descriptor values... without explicit provenance tracking'). The task replaces the required calculation logic with a static lookup, weakening the FR-001 constraint.

Task T033 requires verifying an R² threshold of '>= 0.60' for the top-3 descriptor model. Spec SC-003 defines the success criterion as '≥ 0.2 improvement over null model baseline' with a 95% confidence interval. The task imposes an arbitrary absolute threshold not present in the spec, potentially causing valid results (e.g., R²=0.55 with >0.2 improvement) to fail, thus weakening the acceptance criteria.

Task T035a requires manual curation of `kr_cnt.csv` because 'no verified URL/DOI exists'. This violates Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene: 'No data may be modified in place... every transformation MUST produce a new file with a documented derivation') and Principle I (Reproducibility: 'External datasets MUST be fetched from the same canonical source'). Manual entry introduces non-reproducible human error and lacks a checksummed source, violating the Single Source of Truth.

Task T051 implements 'Cluster-Aware Permutation Engine' to shuffle values 'only among rows sharing the same material_id'. Spec FR-007 requires shuffling 'within material clusters (defined as all entries sharing the same adsorbent structure ID)'. If 'material_id' in the code does not strictly map to 'adsorbent structure ID' (e.g., if it includes adsorbate variations), this task silently relaxes the FR-007 constraint by potentially shuffling across different adsorbents with the same ID or failing to cluster correctly.

Task T032 generates a JSON report `sc002_match_report.json` comparing features to the consensus list. Spec SC-002 requires the report to 'discuss the alignment or divergence... explicitly identifying at least one point of convergence or divergence'. A JSON artifact alone cannot satisfy the 'discuss' (narrative) requirement. The task weakens the acceptance criterion by providing a data structure instead of the required narrative analysis.
